in_marathi.name: Jogeswar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Yoga
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jogeswar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jogeswar is a Sanskrit name derived from two roots: 'Joga' meaning 'yoga' or 'union with the divine', and 'Ishwar' meaning 'Lord'. Thus, Jogeswar refers to the Lord of Yoga or the one who is in union with the divine. This name is commonly used in Hindu tradition and is believed to bring spiritual growth and enlightenment.
